name: Intel OpenVINO Open-Source Inference Toolkit
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source runtime and model optimization toolkit for local CPU, Intel GPU and NPU inference with Python/C++ APIs; no software inference quota.
watch_out: Compute hardware, model licenses, electricity and any optional cloud hosting are separate; some accelerators need supported drivers. OpenVINO telemetry can be opted out; no free hosted model API is included.
